correctedState: Confirmed gap. Two corrections to the original wording. FIX 1 (grep detail): the literal `.claude/CLAUDE.md` has FIVE `.ts` hits, not two, and the base-agent one is at :980, not :972 — `capabilities/types.ts:199`, `agent/base-agent.ts:980`, `agent/memory/memory-store.ts:205`, plus tests `capabilities/__tests__/rules-scope-gating.test.ts:10` and `agent/__tests__/rules-unscoped-launch.test.ts:5`. All five are prose comments, so the substance is unchanged: no code path joins `.claude` to `CLAUDE.md`. FIX 2 (consequence overstated): 'contributes no project context' is true for the launch-time contract but not absolutely. There is one narrow, incidental path — the nested on-demand discovery treats `.claude` as an ordinary subdirectory, so `discoverNestedInstructionFiles(<root>/.claude/settings.json, <root>)` DOES return `<root>/.claude/CLAUDE.md` (measured). That path fires only after the agent touches some file under `<cwd>/.claude/` in the same capability generation, delivers into the message history rather than the pinned block, is capped at `MAX_NESTED_INSTRUCTION_FILES = 8` files and `MAX_NESTED_INSTRUCTION_FILE_BYTES = 10 KiB` per file, and is not re-injected after compaction. Precise statement of the divergence: with the `project` setting source enabled, `<cwd>/.claude/CLAUDE.md` is never loaded at launch and never enters the pinned instruction block; it reaches context only incidentally, if and when a file under `<cwd>/.claude/` is read. Two adjacent facts the original omitted: an ANCESTOR directory's `.claude/CLAUDE.md` is never loaded at all (the `:1077` ancestor walk joins bare names onto each directory, and the nested walk covers only paths strictly below the cwd); and the `--add-dir` opt-in behind `NESSY_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_MEMORY` (`native-sources.ts:928-938`) loads only `<root>/.claude/rules` and `<root>/.agents/rules`, not `.claude/CLAUDE.md` — which contradicts the comment at `capabilities/types.ts:199` that says `--add-dir` loads `.claude/CLAUDE.md`. The smallest fix is to add `.claude/CLAUDE.md` (and, per memory.md, keep `CLAUDE.local.md` at the directory root) to the eager project-instruction join at `native-sources.ts:1077` and `:1088`.
